attributes.name: alphaKr
attributes.description: Dimensionless coefficient used for the rolling stiffness.

attributes.name: alphaKtw
attributes.description: Dimensionless coefficient used for the twist stiffness.

attributes.name: creepBending
attributes.description: Bending creeping coefficient. Usual values between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: creepTension
attributes.description: Tension/compression creeping coefficient. Usual values between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: creepTwist
attributes.description: Twist creeping coefficient. Usual values between 0 and 1.

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: unloadBending
attributes.description: Bending plastic unload coefficient. Usual values between 0 and +infinity.

attributes.name: unloadTension
attributes.description: Tension/compression plastic unload coefficient. Usual values between 0 and +infinity.

attributes.name: unloadTwist
attributes.description: Twist plastic unload coefficient. Usual values between 0 and +infinity.

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.
